76@triton.jit 

77def _musa_flash_delta_serial8( 

78 o, do, BM: tl.constexpr, BD: tl.constexpr, DIM: tl.constexpr 

79): 

80 # Preserve the observed native reduction order: serial groups of eight. 

81 products = o.to(tl.float32) * do.to(tl.float32) 

82 even, odd = tl.split(tl.reshape(products, (BM, BD // 8, 4, 2))) 

83 even04, even26 = tl.split(tl.reshape(even, (BM, BD // 8, 2, 2))) 

84 odd15, odd37 = tl.split(tl.reshape(odd, (BM, BD // 8, 2, 2))) 

85 x0, x4 = tl.split(even04) 

86 x2, x6 = tl.split(even26) 

87 x1, x5 = tl.split(odd15) 

88 x3, x7 = tl.split(odd37) 

89 groups = tl.full((BM, BD // 8), 0, tl.float32) + x0 

90 groups = groups + x1 

91 groups = groups + x2 

92 groups = groups + x3 

93 groups = groups + x4 

94 groups = groups + x5 

95 groups = groups + x6 

96 groups = groups + x7 

97 result = tl.full((BM,), 0, tl.float32) 

98 for i in tl.static_range(0, triton.cdiv(DIM, 8)): 

99 result = result + tl.gather(groups, tl.full((BM, 1), i, tl.int32), 1).reshape( 

100 (BM,) 

101 ) 

102 return result

105@triton.jit 

106def _musa_dropout_scalar( 

107 seed, rng_offset, batch, head, m, n, sq, sk, HQ: tl.constexpr, DROP_P: tl.constexpr 

108): 

109 row_start = ( 

110 (batch.to(tl.uint64) * HQ + head.to(tl.uint64)) * sq + m[:, None].to(tl.uint64) 

111 ) * sk 

112 vector_start = row_start + (n[None, :].to(tl.uint64) // 4) * 4 

113 vector_start = tl.where(vector_start % 8 < 4, vector_start // 4 * 4, vector_start) 

114 index = vector_start + n[None, :].to(tl.uint64) % 4 

115 counter = rng_offset.to(tl.uint64) // 4 + (index % 8) // 4 

116 subsequence = index // 8 

117 c0, c1 = counter.to(tl.uint32), (counter >> 32).to(tl.uint32) 

118 c2, c3 = subsequence.to(tl.uint32), (subsequence >> 32).to(tl.uint32) 

119 seed64 = seed.to(tl.uint64) 

120 k0, k1 = seed64.to(tl.uint32), (seed64 >> 32).to(tl.uint32) 

121 for _ in tl.static_range(10): 

122 hi0, hi1 = tl.umulhi(c0, 0xD2511F53), tl.umulhi(c2, 0xCD9E8D57) 

123 lo0, lo1 = c0 * 0xD2511F53, c2 * 0xCD9E8D57 

124 c0, c1, c2, c3 = hi1 ^ c1 ^ k0, lo1, hi0 ^ c3 ^ k1, lo0 

125 k0, k1 = (k0 + 0x9E3779B9).to(tl.uint32), (k1 + 0xBB67AE85).to(tl.uint32) 

126 lane = index % 4 

127 bits = tl.where(lane == 0, c0, tl.where(lane == 1, c1, tl.where(lane == 2, c2, c3))) 

128 uniform = bits.to(tl.float32) * 2.3283064365386963e-10 

129 return (uniform >= tl.full((), DROP_P, tl.float32)).to(tl.float32)

132@triton.jit 

133def _musa_dropout_group4( 

134 seed, rng_offset, batch, head, m, n, sq, sk, HQ: tl.constexpr, DROP_P: tl.constexpr 

135): 

136 # The host selects this helper only for dense Sk divisible by four. 

137 # Every kernel key vector is contiguous and begins at a multiple of four. 

138 N: tl.constexpr = n.shape[0] 

139 base_n = tl.min(tl.reshape(n, (N // 4, 4)), 1).to(tl.uint64) 

140 row_start = ( 

141 (batch.to(tl.uint64) * HQ + head.to(tl.uint64)) * sq + m[:, None].to(tl.uint64) 

142 ) * sk 

143 index0 = row_start + base_n[None, :] 

144 counter = rng_offset.to(tl.uint64) // 4 + (index0 % 8) // 4 

145 subsequence = index0 // 8 

146 c0, c1 = counter.to(tl.uint32), (counter >> 32).to(tl.uint32) 

147 c2, c3 = subsequence.to(tl.uint32), (subsequence >> 32).to(tl.uint32) 

148 seed64 = seed.to(tl.uint64) 

149 k0, k1 = seed64.to(tl.uint32), (seed64 >> 32).to(tl.uint32) 

150 for _ in tl.static_range(10): 

151 hi0, hi1 = tl.umulhi(c0, 0xD2511F53), tl.umulhi(c2, 0xCD9E8D57) 

152 lo0, lo1 = c0 * 0xD2511F53, c2 * 0xCD9E8D57 

153 c0, c1, c2, c3 = hi1 ^ c1 ^ k0, lo1, hi0 ^ c3 ^ k1, lo0 

154 k0, k1 = (k0 + 0x9E3779B9).to(tl.uint32), (k1 + 0xBB67AE85).to(tl.uint32) 

155 # Nested join adds the last axis: join(02,13) flattens to 0,1,2,3. 

156 words = tl.join(tl.join(c0, c2), tl.join(c1, c3)) 

157 bits = tl.reshape(words, (m.shape[0], N)) 

158 uniform = bits.to(tl.float32) * 2.3283064365386963e-10 

159 return (uniform >= tl.full((), DROP_P, tl.float32)).to(tl.float32)

163def _musa_dropout( 

164 seed, 

165 rng_offset, 

166 batch, 

167 head,

169 n, 

170 sq, 

171 sk, 

172 HQ: tl.constexpr,

175):

186@triton.jit 

187def _musa_flash_probability( 

188 q, 

189 k, 

190 lse, 

191 m, 

192 n, 

193 sq, 

194 sk, 

195 scale, 

196 scale_log2, 

197 LSE_SCALE: tl.constexpr, 

198 WL: tl.constexpr, 

199 WR: tl.constexpr, 

200 TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL: tl.constexpr, 

201 FULL_TILES: tl.constexpr = False, 

202): 

203 scores = tl.dot(q, tl.trans(k)) 

204 offset = 0 if TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL else sk - sq 

205 distance = m[:, None] + offset - n[None, :] 

206 if FULL_TILES: 

207 # Tiles are fully in-bounds: m < sq and n < sk hold for every element, 

208 # so the original shape mask is replaced by a compile-time all-true 

209 # mask of the same (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N) boolean shape. 

210 valid = tl.full(scores.shape, 1, tl.int1) 

211 else: 

212 valid = (m[:, None] < sq) & (n[None, :] < sk) 

213 if WL >= 0: 

214 valid &= distance <= WL 

215 if WR >= 0: 

216 valid &= distance >= -WR 

217 # Native forward uses +inf for empty rows; mathematical oracles may use -inf. 

218 valid &= (lse[:, None] != float("inf")) & (lse[:, None] != -float("inf")) 

219 if scale_log2 is None: 

220 probability = tl.exp(scores * scale - lse[:, None]) 

221 else: 

222 # MuDNN probabilities require the score term to be fused with the 

223 # rounded LSE term before the base-two exponential. 

224 probability = tl.exp2(tl.fma(scores, scale_log2, -lse[:, None] * LSE_SCALE)) 

225 return tl.where(valid, probability, 0.0)

228@triton.jit 

229def _musa_bf16_product(a, b): 

230 # Move rounded FP32 midpoints toward the exact product before BF16 RNE. 

231 product = a * b 

232 bits = product.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True) 

233 residual = tl.fma(a, b, -product) 

234 residual_bits = residual.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True) 

235 grow = ((bits ^ residual_bits) & 0x80000000) == 0 

236 adjusted = bits + tl.where(grow, 1, -1).to(tl.uint32) 

237 midpoint = ((bits & 0xFFFF) == 0x8000) & (residual != 0) 

238 bits = tl.where(midpoint, adjusted, bits) 

239 return bits.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True).to(tl.bfloat16) 

240 

241 

242@triton.jit 

243def _musa_round_probability(p, DTYPE: tl.constexpr): 

244 if DTYPE == tl.bfloat16: 

245 # MUSA removes a plain BF16->FP32 cast roundtrip in the DQ kernel. 

246 # Preserve the native high-D probability rounding explicitly (RNE). 

247 bits = p.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True) 

248 rounded = (bits + 32767 + ((bits >> 16) & 1)) & 0xFFFF0000 

249 rounded = tl.where((bits & 0x7F800000) == 0x7F800000, bits, rounded) 

250 return rounded.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True) 

251 return p.to(DTYPE).to(tl.float32) 

252

254@triton.jit 

255def _musa_split_dot(x, y): 

256 hi = x.to(y.dtype) 

257 # Preserve FP16 residuals during the cast even at small probabilities. 

258 lo = ((x - hi.to(tl.float32)) * 4096.0).to(y.dtype) 

259 return tl.dot(hi, y) + tl.dot(lo, y) * (1.0 / 4096.0)

262@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["seed", "rng_offset", "offset_intragraph"]) 

263def _musa_flash_bwd_dq( 

264 Q, 

265 K, 

266 V, 

267 O, 

268 DO, 

269 LSE, 

270 DELTA, 

271 DQ, 

272 CQ, 

273 CK, 

274 sq_max, 

275 sk_max, 

276 total_q, 

277 HQ: tl.constexpr, 

278 HK: tl.constexpr, 

279 DIM: tl.constexpr, 

280 BD: tl.constexpr, 

281 scale, 

282 scale_log2, 

283 LSE_SCALE: tl.constexpr, 

284 LB: tl.constexpr, 

285 LH: tl.constexpr, 

286 LT: tl.constexpr, 

287 WL: tl.constexpr, 

288 WR: tl.constexpr, 

289 TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL: tl.constexpr, 

290 VARLEN: tl.constexpr, 

291 PADDED_LSE: tl.constexpr, 

292 WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES: tl.constexpr, 

293 BM: tl.constexpr, 

294 BN: tl.constexpr, 

295 FULL_PRECISION: tl.constexpr = False, 

296 ASYNC_LOAD: tl.constexpr = False, 

297 WRITE_DELTA: tl.constexpr = True, 

298 seed=0, 

299 rng_offset=0, 

300 DROP_P: tl.constexpr = 0.0, 

301 DROP_KEEP: tl.constexpr = 1.0, 

302 DROP_GROUP4: tl.constexpr = False, 

303 offset_intragraph=0, 

304 RNG_DEVICE: tl.constexpr = False, 

305 OUT_HEADS: tl.constexpr = 0, 

306 ALIGNED_S: tl.constexpr = 0, 

307): 

308 math_dropout: tl.constexpr = DROP_P > 0 and HQ != HK 

309 drop_scale: tl.constexpr = 0.0 if DROP_KEEP == 0.0 else 1.0 / DROP_KEEP 

310 if DROP_P > 0 and RNG_DEVICE: 

311 seed = tl.load(tl.cast(seed, tl.pointer_type(tl.uint64))) 

312 rng_offset = tl.load( 

313 tl.cast(rng_offset, tl.pointer_type(tl.uint64)) 

314 ) + offset_intragraph.to(tl.uint64) 

315 block = tl.program_id(0) 

316 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES: 

317 block = block.to(tl.int64) 

318 batch = tl.program_id(1).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

319 head = tl.program_id(2).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

320 if VARLEN: 

321 q0 = tl.load(CQ + batch).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

322 k0 = tl.load(CK + batch).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

323 sq = ( 

324 tl.load(CQ + batch + 1).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

325 - q0 

326 ) 

327 sk = ( 

328 tl.load(CK + batch + 1).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

329 - k0 

330 ) 

331 lbase = head * LH + q0 * LT 

332 if PADDED_LSE: 

333 lbase = batch * LB + head * LH 

334 else: 

335 sq, sk = sq_max, sk_max 

336 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES: 

337 sq, sk = tl.cast(sq, tl.int64), tl.cast(sk, tl.int64) 

338 q0, k0 = batch * sq, batch * sk 

339 lbase = batch * LB + head * LH 

340 m = (block * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)).to( 

341 tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32 

342 ) 

343 n = tl.arange(0, BN).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

344 d = tl.arange(0, BD) 

345 qi = ((q0 + m[:, None]) * HQ + head) * DIM + d[None, :] 

346 if ALIGNED_S: 

347 # Confirmed dense square D64 tile: BM divides sq, BN divides sk and 

348 # DIM == BD, so every row/feature lane of the tile is in bounds. 

349 qm = tl.full((BM, BD), 1, tl.int1) 

350 else: 

351 qm = (m[:, None] < sq) & (d[None, :] < DIM) 

352 q = _musa_matrix_load(Q + qi, qm, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

353 do = _musa_matrix_load(DO + qi, qm, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

354 if OUT_HEADS: 

355 # Native O keeps BSHD storage while independent heads are folded into B. 

356 oi = ( 

357 (batch // OUT_HEADS * sq + m[:, None]) * OUT_HEADS + batch % OUT_HEADS 

358 ) * DIM + d[None, :] 

359 else: 

360 oi = qi 

361 if ALIGNED_S: 

362 o = tl.load(O + oi).to(tl.float32) 

363 else: 

364 o = tl.load(O + oi, qm, 0).to(tl.float32) 

365 if FULL_PRECISION: 

366 delta = tl.sum(o * do.to(tl.float32), 1) 

367 elif DIM <= 128: 

368 # The native preprocessing kernel uses this order for both low dtypes. 

369 delta = _musa_flash_delta_serial8(o, do, BM, BD, DIM) 

370 else: 

371 delta_matrix = tl.dot(o.to(do.dtype), tl.trans(do)) 

372 diagonal = tl.arange(0, BM) 

373 delta = tl.sum( 

374 tl.where(diagonal[:, None] == diagonal[None, :], delta_matrix, 0.0), 1 

375 ) 

376 if WRITE_DELTA: 

377 if ALIGNED_S: 

378 tl.store(DELTA + head * total_q + q0 + m, delta) 

379 else: 

380 tl.store(DELTA + head * total_q + q0 + m, delta, m < sq) 

381 if ALIGNED_S: 

382 lse = tl.load(LSE + lbase + m * LT) 

383 delta_scale = -(delta * scale) 

384 else: 

385 lse = tl.load(LSE + lbase + m * LT, m < sq, float("inf")) 

386 dq = tl.full((BM, BD), 0, tl.float32) 

387 lo = 0 

388 hi = sk 

389 offset = 0 if TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL else sk - sq 

390 if WL >= 0: 

391 lo = tl.maximum(0, block * BM + offset - WL) 

392 if WR >= 0: 

393 hi = tl.minimum(sk, (block + 1) * BM + offset + WR) 

394 if ALIGNED_S: 

395 # Dense square rows: the tile window is already an exact multiple of BN. 

396 start = lo // BN 

397 stop = hi // BN 

398 else: 

399 start = lo // BN 

400 stop = tl.cdiv(tl.maximum(hi, 0), BN) 

401 for tile in range(start, stop): 

402 kn = tile * BN + n 

403 ki = ((k0 + kn[:, None]) * HK + head // (HQ // HK)) * DIM + d[None, :] 

404 if ALIGNED_S: 

405 km = tl.full((BN, BD), 1, tl.int1) 

406 else: 

407 km = (kn[:, None] < sk) & (d[None, :] < DIM) 

408 k = _musa_matrix_load(K + ki, km, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

409 v = _musa_matrix_load(V + ki, km, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

410 p = _musa_flash_probability( 

411 q, 

412 k, 

413 lse, 

414 m, 

415 kn, 

416 sq, 

417 sk, 

418 scale, 

419 scale_log2, 

420 LSE_SCALE, 

421 WL, 

422 WR, 

423 TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL, 

424 FULL_TILES=ALIGNED_S, 

425 ) 

426 dp = tl.dot(do, tl.trans(v)) 

427 # Some NPU dot lowerings leave out-of-bounds tile lanes undefined. 

428 # A zero probability does not suppress a NaN in those lanes. 

429 if not ALIGNED_S: 

430 dp_valid = (m[:, None] < sq) & (kn[None, :] < sk) 

431 dp = tl.where(dp_valid, dp, 0.0) 

432 if DROP_P > 0: 

433 dp *= _musa_dropout( 

434 seed, rng_offset, batch, head, m, kn, sq, sk, HQ, DROP_P, DROP_GROUP4 

435 ) 

436 # MuDNN MHA dropout and D224/D256 MHA round P before forming dS. 

437 if ( 

438 not FULL_PRECISION 

439 and not math_dropout 

440 and (DROP_P > 0 or DIM == 224 or DIM == 256) 

441 ): 

442 p = _musa_round_probability(p, q.dtype) 

443 # In the mathematical dropout path, delay the reciprocal until 

444 # after accumulation to avoid widening the dot operands' range. 

445 ds = p * (dp - delta[:, None] * (DROP_KEEP if math_dropout else 1.0)) 

446 if DROP_P > 0 and not math_dropout: 

447 # Match measured MuDNN backward saved-state semantics: forward O 

448 # already includes dropout scaling, while backward scales the 

449 # entire masked-dP minus dot(O,dO) difference once more. 

450 if DROP_KEEP == 0.0: 

451 ds *= 0.0 

452 else: 

453 ds *= 1.0 / DROP_KEEP 

454 if not ALIGNED_S: 

455 ds_valid = (m[:, None] < sq) & (kn[None, :] < sk) 

456 ds = tl.where(ds_valid, ds, 0.0) 

457 # MuDNN scales dS before its low-precision tensor-core operand cast. 

458 if FULL_PRECISION: 

459 dq += tl.dot(ds * scale, k.to(tl.float32), input_precision="ieee") 

460 elif math_dropout: 

461 dq += _musa_split_dot(ds * scale, k) 

462 else: 

463 if q.dtype == tl.bfloat16 and DROP_P == 0 and DIM <= 128: 

464 if ALIGNED_S: 

465 ds_scaled = _musa_bf16_product( 

466 p, tl.fma(dp, scale, delta_scale[:, None]) 

467 ) 

468 else: 

469 ds_scaled = _musa_bf16_product( 

470 p, tl.fma(dp, scale, -delta[:, None] * scale) 

471 ) 

472 ds_scaled = tl.where(ds_valid, ds_scaled, 0.0) 

473 elif q.dtype == tl.float16 and DROP_P == 0: 

474 # Preserve a fused scaled difference to align FP16 native rounding. 

475 if ALIGNED_S: 

476 ds_scaled = p * tl.fma(dp, scale, delta_scale[:, None]) 

477 else: 

478 ds_scaled = p * tl.fma(dp, scale, -delta[:, None] * scale) 

479 ds_scaled = tl.where(ds_valid, ds_scaled, 0.0) 

480 else: 

481 ds_scaled = ds * scale 

482 dq += tl.dot(ds_scaled.to(q.dtype), k) 

483 if math_dropout: 

484 dq *= drop_scale 

485 if ALIGNED_S: 

486 tl.store(DQ + qi, dq) 

487 else: 

488 tl.store(DQ + qi, tl.where(sk > 0, dq, 0.0), qm)

492def _musa_flash_bwd_dkv( 

493 Q, 

494 K, 

495 V,

500 DK,

520 VARLEN: tl.constexpr, 

521 PADDED_LSE: tl.constexpr, 

522 WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES: tl.constexpr, 

523 BM: tl.constexpr, 

524 BN: tl.constexpr, 

525 FULL_PRECISION: tl.constexpr = False, 

526 ASYNC_LOAD: tl.constexpr = False, 

527 HEAD_OFFSET: tl.constexpr = 0, 

528 COMPUTE_DELTA: tl.constexpr = False, 

529 seed=0, 

530 rng_offset=0, 

531 DROP_P: tl.constexpr = 0.0, 

532 DROP_KEEP: tl.constexpr = 1.0, 

533 DROP_GROUP4: tl.constexpr = False, 

534 offset_intragraph=0, 

535 RNG_DEVICE: tl.constexpr = False, 

536 ALIGNED_S: tl.constexpr = 0, 

537): 

538 math_dropout: tl.constexpr = DROP_P > 0 and HQ != HK 

539 drop_scale: tl.constexpr = 0.0 if DROP_KEEP == 0.0 else 1.0 / DROP_KEEP 

540 if DROP_P > 0 and RNG_DEVICE: 

541 seed = tl.load(tl.cast(seed, tl.pointer_type(tl.uint64))) 

542 rng_offset = tl.load( 

543 tl.cast(rng_offset, tl.pointer_type(tl.uint64)) 

544 ) + offset_intragraph.to(tl.uint64) 

545 block = tl.program_id(0) 

546 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES: 

547 block = block.to(tl.int64) 

548 batch = tl.program_id(1).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

549 head_k = ( 

550 tl.program_id(2).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

551 - HEAD_OFFSET 

552 ) 

553 if VARLEN: 

554 q0 = tl.load(CQ + batch).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

555 k0 = tl.load(CK + batch).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

556 sq = ( 

557 tl.load(CQ + batch + 1).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

558 - q0 

559 ) 

560 sk = ( 

561 tl.load(CK + batch + 1).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

562 - k0 

563 ) 

564 lbase = q0 * LT 

565 if PADDED_LSE: 

566 lbase = batch * LB 

567 else: 

568 sq, sk = sq_max, sk_max 

569 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES: 

570 sq, sk = tl.cast(sq, tl.int64), tl.cast(sk, tl.int64) 

571 q0, k0 = batch * sq, batch * sk 

572 lbase = batch * LB 

573 m = tl.arange(0, BM).to(tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32) 

574 n = (block * BN + tl.arange(0, BN)).to( 

575 tl.int64 if WIDE_SEQUENCE_INDICES else tl.int32 

576 ) 

577 d = tl.arange(0, BD) 

578 ki = ((k0 + n[:, None]) * HK + head_k) * DIM + d[None, :] 

579 if ALIGNED_S: 

580 # D64, S==1024 aligned dense tiles: every K/V row and feature index is 

581 # in bounds, so the qm/n/d masks are provably all-true here. 

582 k = tl.load(K + ki) 

583 v = tl.load(V + ki) 

584 else: 

585 km = (n[:, None] < sk) & (d[None, :] < DIM) 

586 k = _musa_matrix_load(K + ki, km, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

587 v = _musa_matrix_load(V + ki, km, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

588 dk = tl.full((BN, BD), 0, tl.float32) 

589 dv = tl.full((BN, BD), 0, tl.float32) 

590 lo = 0 

591 hi = sq 

592 offset = 0 if TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL else sk - sq 

593 if WR >= 0: 

594 lo = tl.maximum(0, block * BN - offset - WR) 

595 if WL >= 0: 

596 hi = tl.minimum(sq, (block + 1) * BN - offset + WL) 

597 # MuDNN accumulates the query-head contributions in FP32 before the final 

598 # GQA output cast. Keep disjoint writes and fixed-order group reduction. 

599 for group in range(HQ // HK): 

600 head = head_k * (HQ // HK) + group 

601 dk_head = tl.full((BN, BD), 0, tl.float32) 

602 dv_head = tl.full((BN, BD), 0, tl.float32) 

603 for tile in range(lo // BM, tl.cdiv(tl.maximum(hi, 0), BM)): 

604 qm = tile * BM + m 

605 qi = ((q0 + qm[:, None]) * HQ + head) * DIM + d[None, :] 

606 if ALIGNED_S: 

607 q = tl.load(Q + qi) 

608 do = tl.load(DO + qi) 

609 else: 

610 mask = (qm[:, None] < sq) & (d[None, :] < DIM) 

611 q = _musa_matrix_load(Q + qi, mask, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

612 do = _musa_matrix_load(DO + qi, mask, FULL_PRECISION, DIM, ASYNC_LOAD) 

613 if COMPUTE_DELTA: 

614 if ALIGNED_S: 

615 o = tl.load(O + qi).to(tl.float32) 

616 else: 

617 o = tl.load(O + qi, (qm[:, None] < sq) & (d[None, :] < DIM), 0).to( 

618 tl.float32 

619 ) 

620 if FULL_PRECISION: 

621 delta = tl.sum(o * do.to(tl.float32), 1) 

622 elif DIM <= 128: 

623 delta = _musa_flash_delta_serial8(o, do, BM, BD, DIM) 

624 else: 

625 delta_matrix = tl.dot(o.to(do.dtype), tl.trans(do)) 

626 diagonal = tl.arange(0, BM) 

627 delta = tl.sum( 

628 tl.where( 

629 diagonal[:, None] == diagonal[None, :], delta_matrix, 0.0 

630 ), 

631 1, 

632 ) 

633 else: 

634 if ALIGNED_S: 

635 delta = tl.load(DELTA + head * total_q + q0 + qm) 

636 else: 

637 delta = tl.load(DELTA + head * total_q + q0 + qm, qm < sq, 0) 

638 if ALIGNED_S: 

639 lse = tl.load(LSE + lbase + head * LH + qm * LT) 

640 else: 

641 lse = tl.load(LSE + lbase + head * LH + qm * LT, qm < sq, float("inf")) 

642 p = _musa_flash_probability( 

643 q, 

644 k, 

645 lse, 

646 qm, 

647 n, 

648 sq, 

649 sk, 

650 scale, 

651 scale_log2, 

652 LSE_SCALE, 

653 WL, 

654 WR, 

655 TOP_LEFT_CAUSAL, 

656 FULL_TILES=ALIGNED_S, 

657 ) 

658 dp = tl.dot(do, tl.trans(v)) 

659 if not ALIGNED_S: 

660 dp = tl.where((qm[:, None] < sq) & (n[None, :] < sk), dp, 0.0) 

661 p_drop = p 

662 if DROP_P > 0: 

663 keep = _musa_dropout( 

664 seed, 

665 rng_offset, 

666 batch, 

667 head, 

668 qm, 

669 n, 

670 sq, 

671 sk, 

672 HQ, 

673 DROP_P, 

674 DROP_GROUP4, 

675 ) 

676 dp *= keep 

677 p_drop *= keep 

678 # MuDNN dropout and D224/D256 MHA round P before forming dS. 

679 if ( 

680 not FULL_PRECISION 

681 and not math_dropout 

682 and (DROP_P > 0 or DIM == 224 or DIM == 256) 

683 ): 

684 p = _musa_round_probability(p, q.dtype) 

685 # In the mathematical dropout path, delay the reciprocal until 

686 # after accumulation to avoid widening the dot operands' range. 

687 ds = p * (dp - delta[:, None] * (DROP_KEEP if math_dropout else 1.0)) 

688 if DROP_P > 0 and not math_dropout: 

689 if DROP_KEEP == 0.0: 

690 ds *= 0.0 

691 else: 

692 ds *= 1.0 / DROP_KEEP 

693 if not ALIGNED_S: 

694 ds = tl.where((qm[:, None] < sq) & (n[None, :] < sk), ds, 0.0) 

695 if FULL_PRECISION: 

696 dk_head += tl.dot( 

697 tl.trans(ds * scale), q.to(tl.float32), input_precision="ieee" 

698 ) 

699 dv_head += tl.dot( 

700 tl.trans(p_drop), do.to(tl.float32), input_precision="ieee" 

701 ) 

702 elif math_dropout: 

703 dk_head += _musa_split_dot(tl.trans(ds * scale), q) 

704 dv_head += _musa_split_dot(tl.trans(p_drop), do) 

705 else: 

706 if q.dtype == tl.bfloat16 and DROP_P == 0 and DIM <= 128: 

707 ds_scaled = _musa_bf16_product( 

708 p, tl.fma(dp, scale, -delta[:, None] * scale) 

709 ) 

710 if not ALIGNED_S: 

711 ds_scaled = tl.where( 

712 (qm[:, None] < sq) & (n[None, :] < sk), ds_scaled, 0.0 

713 ) 

714 elif q.dtype == tl.float16 and DROP_P == 0: 

715 ds_scaled = p * tl.fma(dp, scale, -delta[:, None] * scale) 

716 if not ALIGNED_S: 

717 ds_scaled = tl.where( 

718 (qm[:, None] < sq) & (n[None, :] < sk), ds_scaled, 0.0 

719 ) 

720 else: 

721 ds_scaled = ds * scale 

722 dk_head += tl.dot(tl.trans(ds_scaled.to(q.dtype)), q) 

723 dv_operand = p_drop 

724 if DROP_P > 0: 

725 dv_operand = _musa_round_probability(p_drop, q.dtype) 

726 if DROP_KEEP == 0.0: 

727 dv_operand *= 0.0 

728 else: 

729 dv_operand /= DROP_KEEP 

730 dv_head += tl.dot(tl.trans(dv_operand.to(q.dtype)), do) 

731 dk += dk_head 

732 dv += dv_head 

733 if math_dropout: 

734 dk *= drop_scale 

735 dv *= drop_scale 

736 if ALIGNED_S: 

737 tl.store(DK + ki, tl.where(sq > 0, dk, 0.0)) 

738 tl.store(DV + ki, tl.where(sq > 0, dv, 0.0)) 

739 else: 

740 tl.store(DK + ki, tl.where(sq > 0, dk, 0.0), km) 

741 tl.store(DV + ki, tl.where(sq > 0, dv, 0.0), km) 

742 

743

866@triton.jit 

867def _musa_flash_tail_metadata(CQ, CK, FLAG, batch, BLOCK: tl.constexpr): 

868 # One program initializes the sole flag, using bounded metadata tiles. 

869 lane = tl.arange(0, BLOCK).to(tl.int64) 

870 invalid = tl.full((), False, tl.int1) 

871 for start in range(tl.cdiv(batch, BLOCK)): 

872 index = start * BLOCK + lane 

873 valid = index < batch 

874 sq = tl.load(CQ + index + 1, valid, 0).to(tl.int64) - tl.load( 

875 CQ + index, valid, 0 

876 ).to(tl.int64) 

877 sk = tl.load(CK + index + 1, valid, 0).to(tl.int64) - tl.load( 

878 CK + index, valid, 0 

879 ).to(tl.int64) 

880 invalid = invalid | ( 

881 tl.sum((valid & (sk > tl.cdiv(sq, 128) * 128)).to(tl.int32), 0) > 0 

882 ) 

883 tl.store(FLAG, invalid.to(tl.int32))

1046@triton.jit 

1047def _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_delta( 

1048 O, 

1049 DO, 

1050 DELTA, 

1051 DQA, 

1052 S: tl.constexpr, 

1053 H: tl.constexpr, 

1054 D: tl.constexpr, 

1055 OB: tl.constexpr, 

1056 OH: tl.constexpr, 

1057 OS: tl.constexpr, 

1058 BM: tl.constexpr, 

1059 LSE=None, 

1060 SCALE: tl.constexpr = 1.0, 

1061): 

1062 bh = tl.program_id(1) 

1063 m = tl.program_id(0) * BM + tl.arange(0, BM) 

1064 d = tl.arange(0, D) 

1065 do = tl.load(DO + (bh * S + m[:, None]) * D + d[None, :], m[:, None] < S, 0) 

1066 o = tl.load( 

1067 O + (bh // H) * OB + (bh % H) * OH + m[:, None] * OS + d[None, :], 

1068 m[:, None] < S, 

1069 0, 

1070 ) 

1071 delta = _musa_flash_delta_serial8(o, do, BM, D, D) 

1072 offset = bh * S + m 

1073 if LSE is None: 

1074 tl.store(DELTA + offset, delta, m < S) 

1075 else: 

1076 # The SDK consumes a pair of already scaled row statistics. 

1077 lse = tl.load(LSE + offset, m < S, other=float("inf")) 

1078 lse = tl.where(tl.abs(lse) < float("inf"), lse, float(1 << 30)) 

1079 stats = tl.interleave(lse * 1.4426950408889634, delta * SCALE) 

1080 pair = 2 * tl.program_id(0) * BM + tl.arange(0, 2 * BM) 

1081 tl.store(DELTA + 2 * bh * S + pair, stats, pair < 2 * S) 

1082 

1083 tl.store(DQA + (bh * S + m[:, None]) * D + d[None, :], 0.0, m[:, None] < S) 

1084 

1085 

1086@triton.jit 

1087def _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_ds( 

1088 score, 

1089 dp, 

1090 LSE, 

1091 DELTA, 

1092 m, 

1093 n, 

1094 SQ: tl.constexpr, 

1095 SK: tl.constexpr, 

1096 SCALE, 

1097 SCALE2, 

1098 DTYPE: tl.constexpr, 

1099 CAUSAL: tl.constexpr, 

1100): 

1101 lse = tl.load(LSE + m) 

1102 delta = tl.load(DELTA + m) 

1103 p = tl.exp2(tl.fma(score, SCALE2, -lse[:, None] * 1.4426950408889634)) 

1104 if CAUSAL: 

1105 p = tl.where(m[:, None] % SQ >= n[None, :] % SK, p, 0.0) 

1106 if DTYPE == tl.bfloat16: 

1107 ds = _musa_bf16_product(p, tl.fma(dp, SCALE, -delta[:, None] * SCALE)) 

1108 else: 

1109 ds = (p * tl.fma(dp, SCALE, -delta[:, None] * SCALE)).to(DTYPE) 

1110 return p.to(DTYPE), ds

1124 SQ: tl.constexpr, 

1125 SK: tl.constexpr, 

1126 D: tl.constexpr, 

1127 BM: tl.constexpr, 

1128 BN: tl.constexpr, 

1129 BD: tl.constexpr, 

1130 BH: tl.constexpr, 

1131 NUM_SMS: tl.constexpr, 

1132 CAUSAL: tl.constexpr, 

1133 SCALE, 

1134 SCALE2, 

1135): 

1136 qtiles: tl.constexpr = tl.cdiv(SQ, BM) 

1137 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

1138 for job in range(pid, BH * (SK // BN), NUM_SMS): 

1139 bh = job % BH 

1140 block = job // BH 

1141 n = bh * SK + block * BN + tl.arange(0, BN) 

1142 d = tl.arange(0, BD) 

1143 kv = n[:, None] * D + d[None, :] 

1144 if CAUSAL: 

1145 k = tl.load(K + n[:, None] * D + d[None, :], d[None, :] < D, 0) 

1146 v = tl.load(V + n[:, None] * D + d[None, :], d[None, :] < D, 0) 

1147 else: 

1148 k = tl.load(K + kv, eviction_policy="evict_last") 

1149 v = tl.load(V + kv, eviction_policy="evict_last") 

1150 ak = tl.zeros((BN, BD), tl.float32) 

1151 av = tl.zeros((BN, BD), tl.float32) 

1152 start = 0 

1153 if CAUSAL: 

1154 start = block * BN // BM 

1155 qcount = qtiles - start 

1156 shift = block % qcount 

1157 rows = tl.arange(0, BM) 

1158 for it in range(qcount): 

1159 t = start + it + shift 

1160 t = tl.where(t >= qtiles, t - qcount, t) 

1161 m = bh * SQ + t * BM + rows 

1162 qp = m[:, None] * D + d[None, :] 

1163 if CAUSAL: 

1164 q = tl.load(Q + m[:, None] * D + d[None, :], d[None, :] < D, 0) 

1165 do = tl.load(DO + m[:, None] * D + d[None, :], d[None, :] < D, 0) 

1166 else: 

1167 q = tl.load(Q + qp, eviction_policy="evict_first") 

1168 do = tl.load(DO + qp, eviction_policy="evict_first") 

1169 score = tl.dot(q, tl.trans(k)) 

1170 dp = tl.dot(do, tl.trans(v)) 

1171 if CAUSAL: 

1172 # Native masked path, unchanged arithmetic for the causal case. 

1173 p, ds = _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_ds( 

1174 score, 

1175 dp, 

1176 LSE, 

1177 DELTA, 

1178 m, 

1179 n, 

1180 SQ, 

1181 SK, 

1182 SCALE, 

1183 SCALE2, 

1184 DK.dtype.element_ty, 

1185 CAUSAL, 

1186 ) 

1187 else: 

1188 lse = tl.load(LSE + m) 

1189 delta = tl.load(DELTA + m) 

1190 p = tl.exp2(tl.fma(score, SCALE2, -lse[:, None] * 1.4426950408889634)) 

1191 if DK.dtype.element_ty == tl.bfloat16: 

1192 ds = _musa_bf16_product( 

1193 p, tl.fma(dp, SCALE, -delta[:, None] * SCALE) 

1194 ) 

1195 else: 

1196 ds = (p * tl.fma(dp, SCALE, -delta[:, None] * SCALE)).to( 

1197 DK.dtype.element_ty 

1198 ) 

1199 p = p.to(DK.dtype.element_ty) 

1200 # Same FP32 reduction and rotated tile order as the reference. 

1201 ak = tl.dot(tl.trans(ds), q, ak) 

1202 av = tl.dot(tl.trans(p), do, av) 

1203 dq = tl.dot(ds, k) 

1204 if CAUSAL: 

1205 tl.atomic_add( 

1206 DQA + m[:, None] * D + d[None, :], 

1207 dq, 

1208 mask=d[None, :] < D, 

1209 sem="relaxed", 

1210 ) 

1211 else: 

1212 tl.atomic_add(DQA + qp, dq, sem="relaxed") 

1213 if CAUSAL: 

1214 idx = n[:, None] * D + d[None, :] 

1215 tl.store(DK + idx, ak.to(DK.dtype.element_ty), d[None, :] < D) 

1216 tl.store(DV + idx, av.to(DV.dtype.element_ty), d[None, :] < D) 

1217 else: 

1218 tl.store(DK + kv, ak.to(DK.dtype.element_ty)) 

1219 tl.store(DV + kv, av.to(DV.dtype.element_ty)) 

1220 tl.debug_barrier() 

1221 

1222 

1223@triton.jit 

1224def _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_cast(DQA, DQ, N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr): 

1225 i = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

1226 tl.store(DQ + i, tl.load(DQA + i, i < N, 0).to(DQ.dtype.element_ty), i < N) 

1227 

1228 

1229def flash_attention_backward( 

1230 grad_out, 

1231 query, 

1232 key, 

1233 value, 

1234 out, 

1235 logsumexp, 

1236 cum_seq_q, 

1237 cum_seq_k, 

1238 max_q, 

1239 max_k, 

1240 dropout_p, 

1241 is_causal, 

1242 rng_state, 

1243 unused, 

1244 *, 

1245 scale=None, 

1246 window_size_left=None, 

1247 window_size_right=None, 

1248): 

1249 logger.debug("GEMS_MTHREADS FLASH_ATTENTION_BACKWARD") 

1250 # torch-musa 2.9.1 forwards the dense ATen call directly to MuDNN's 

1251 # BHSD SDPA entry. Normalize that producer ABI before the shared kernel. 

1252 musa_dense = query.ndim == 4 

1253 # Independent head/batch controls expose MuDNN D160 dQ dependence on a 

1254 # neighboring logical K segment in an incomplete 128-key tile. Only tensor 

1255 # metadata selects the same-saved-state math path below; no device read or 

1256 # native call participates in implementation dispatch. 

1257 dense_key_contiguous = musa_dense and key.is_contiguous() 

1258 if musa_dense: 

1259 query, key, value, out, grad_out = ( 

1260 t.transpose(1, 2) for t in (query, key, value, out, grad_out) 

1261 ) 

1262 # Validate metadata without reading device values or synchronizing the stream. 

1263 varlen = query.ndim == 3 

1264 rank = 3 if varlen else 4 

1265 if query.ndim not in (3, 4) or any( 

1266 t.ndim != rank for t in (key, value, out, grad_out) 

1267 ): 

1268 raise ValueError("flash_attention_backward expects BHSD or packed THD tensors") 

1269 if any( 

1270 t.dtype != query.dtype for t in (key, value, out, grad_out) 

1271 ) or query.dtype not in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16): 

1272 raise ValueError( 

1273 "flash_attention_backward requires matching float16 or bfloat16 tensors" 

1274 ) 

1275 if any(t.device != query.device for t in (key, value, out, grad_out, logsumexp)): 

1276 raise ValueError("flash_attention_backward tensors must be on the same device") 

1277 if ( 

1278 query.shape != out.shape 

1279 or query.shape != grad_out.shape 

1280 or key.shape != value.shape 

1281 ): 

1282 raise ValueError("incompatible query/output/gradient or key/value shapes") 

1283 dim, hq, hk = query.shape[-1], query.shape[-2], key.shape[-2] 

1284 if dim != key.shape[-1] or dim <= 0 or dim > 256 or dim % 8: 

1285 raise ValueError("head dimension must match and be a multiple of 8 in [8, 256]") 

1286 if hq <= 0 or hk <= 0 or hq % hk: 

1287 raise ValueError("query heads must be a positive multiple of KV heads") 

1288 if any(t.stride(-1) != 1 for t in (query, key, value, out)): 

1289 raise ValueError( 

1290 "query, key, value and out must have contiguous last dimensions" 

1291 ) 

1292 if not 0.0 <= dropout_p < 1.0: 

1293 raise ValueError("dropout_p must be in [0, 1)") 

1294 seed = rng_offset = offset_intragraph = 0 

1295 rng_device = False 

1296 if dropout_p: 

1297 # MuDNN PH1 backward subtracts float32(p) from one in float32, 

1298 # although its host descriptor accepts double. Keep the mask unchanged. 

1299 dropout_keep = struct.unpack( 

1300 "f", 

1301 struct.pack("f", 1.0 - struct.unpack("f", struct.pack("f", dropout_p))[0]), 

1302 )[0] 

1303 # MuDNN PH1 host lowering selects a zero reciprocal when p32 >= 1. 

1304 # Preserve the device arithmetic path instead of rejecting legal p < 1. 

1305 if window_size_left is not None or window_size_right is not None: 

1306 raise NotImplementedError("native MUSA dropout has no local-window ABI") 

1307 if dim in (136, 144, 152, 192): 

1308 raise NotImplementedError("native MUSA dropout dimension is not validated") 

1309 if not musa_dense: 

1310 raise NotImplementedError("native MUSA dropout requires dense inputs") 

1311 if hq != hk: 

1312 from torch_musa.core import mudnn 

1313 

1314 sq, sk = query.shape[1], key.shape[1] 

1315 # The native forward mask has been verified for aligned causal D80 

1316 # GQA on S5000 with MuDNN 3400. Compute its mathematical backward. 

1317 if not ( 

1318 is_causal 

1319 and (scale is None or scale >= 0.0) 

1320 and dim == 80 

1321 and 0 < sq <= sk 

1322 and sq % 128 == 0 

1323 and sk % 128 == 0 

1324 and mudnn.version() == 3400 

1325 and "S5000" in torch.musa.get_device_name(query.device) 

1326 ): 

1327 raise NotImplementedError( 

1328 "MUSA GQA dropout requires aligned causal D80 on S5000/MuDNN 3400 and nonnegative scale" 

1329 ) 

1330 if not ( 

1331 isinstance(rng_state, torch.Tensor) 

1332 and rng_state.device.type == "cpu" 

1333 and rng_state.dtype == torch.uint64 

1334 and rng_state.ndim == 1 

1335 and rng_state.numel() in (2, 3) 

1336 and rng_state.is_contiguous() 

1337 ): 

1338 raise NotImplementedError( 

1339 "expected native CPU uint64[2] or uint64[3] RNG state" 

1340 ) 

1341 if hq != hk and rng_state.numel() != 2: 

1342 raise NotImplementedError("MUSA GQA dropout requires eager Philox state") 

1343 # MuDNN stores ordinary seed/offset on CPU. In graph mode its three 

1344 # CPU words hold two device addresses and an intragraph offset; the 

1345 # device kernel dereferences those addresses without a host readback. 

1346 state_values = rng_state.tolist() 

1347 seed, rng_offset = state_values[:2] 

1348 rng_device = len(state_values) == 3 

1349 if rng_device: 

1350 offset_intragraph = state_values[2] 

1351 wl = -1 if window_size_left is None else window_size_left 

1352 wr = -1 if window_size_right is None else window_size_right 

1353 wl, wr = max(-1, wl), max(-1, wr) 

1354 if is_causal: 

1355 wr = 0 

1356 if max_q < 0 or max_k < 0: 

1357 raise ValueError("maximum sequence lengths must be nonnegative") 

1358 # MuDNN saves dense and packed forward LSE in padded BHS layout. 

1359 padded_lse = True 

1360 if varlen: 

1361 if cum_seq_q is None or cum_seq_k is None: 

1362 raise ValueError("packed tensors require both cumulative sequence arrays") 

1363 for cu in (cum_seq_q, cum_seq_k): 

1364 if ( 

1365 cu.dtype != torch.int32 

1366 or cu.device != query.device 

1367 or cu.ndim != 1 

1368 or not cu.is_contiguous() 

1369 or cu.numel() < 1 

1370 ): 

1371 raise ValueError("cu_seqlens must be contiguous device int32 vectors") 

1372 if cum_seq_q.shape != cum_seq_k.shape: 

1373 raise ValueError("cumulative sequence arrays must have equal lengths") 

1374 batch = cum_seq_q.numel() - 1 

1375 total_q = query.shape[0] 

1376 expected_lse = (hq, total_q) 

1377 lb, lh, lt = ( 

1378 0, 

1379 logsumexp.stride(0) if logsumexp.ndim == 2 else 0, 

1380 logsumexp.stride(1) if logsumexp.ndim == 2 else 0, 

1381 ) 

1382 if padded_lse: 

1383 expected_lse = (batch, hq, max_q) 

1384 lb, lh, lt = logsumexp.stride() if logsumexp.ndim == 3 else (0, 0, 0) 

1385 # Monotone offsets, endpoints and per-sequence maxima are caller preconditions, 

1386 # as in native FlashAttention. Checking their values would synchronize here. 

1387 if (max_q == 0 and total_q) or (max_k == 0 and key.shape[0]): 

1388 raise ValueError("nonempty packed inputs need nonzero maximum lengths") 

1389 else: 

1390 if cum_seq_q is not None or cum_seq_k is not None: 

1391 raise ValueError( 

1392 "dense tensors require undefined cumulative sequence arrays" 

1393 ) 

1394 batch, sq = query.shape[:2] 

1395 if key.shape[0] != batch: 

1396 raise ValueError("query and key batch sizes must match") 

1397 max_q, max_k = sq, key.shape[1] 

1398 total_q = batch * sq 

1399 expected_lse = (batch, hq, sq) 

1400 lb, lh, lt = logsumexp.stride() if logsumexp.ndim == 3 else (0, 0, 0) 

1401 if logsumexp.dtype != torch.float32 or tuple(logsumexp.shape) != expected_lse: 

1402 raise ValueError(f"logsumexp must be float32 with shape {expected_lse}") 

1403 # Explicit windows use the mathematical mask; MuDNN has no window ABI. 

1404 # MuDNN treats zero as its default-scale sentinel for its supported ABI. 

1405 # Explicit windows are a Gems extension and retain mathematical zero. 

1406 native_default_scale = scale is None or ( 

1407 scale == 0 and window_size_left is None and window_size_right is None 

1408 ) 

1409 # Round the reciprocal square root once in the kernel argument. Rounding 

1410 # sqrt(D) first changes the D24/D96 coefficient by one FP32 ULP. 

1411 default_scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(dim) 

1412 scale = default_scale if native_default_scale else scale 

1413 scale_log2 = None 

1414 lse_scale = math.log2(math.e) 

1415 launch_options = { 

1416 # This optional load route has device evidence only on S5000/mp31. 

1417 "ASYNC_LOAD": ( 

1418 dropout_p == 0 

1419 and _HAS_ASYNC_LOAD 

1420 and dim == 128 

1421 and "S5000" in torch.musa.get_device_name(query.device) 

1422 ), 

1423 "FULL_PRECISION": ( 

1424 window_size_left is not None 

1425 or window_size_right is not None 

1426 or ( 

1427 dropout_p == 0 

1428 and not varlen 

1429 and is_causal 

1430 and dim <= 160 

1431 and max_k > triton.cdiv(max_q, 128) * 128 

1432 ) 

1433 or dim in (136, 144, 152, 192) 

1434 or (varlen and dim == 160) 

1435 or ( 

1436 dropout_p == 0 

1437 and not varlen 

1438 and dim == 160 

1439 and max_k % 128 != 0 

1440 and (batch > 1 or (dense_key_contiguous and hk > 1)) 

1441 and (not is_causal or max_q > max_k) 

1442 ) 

1443 or (hq > hk and dim in (224, 256)) 

1444 ), 

1445 } 

1446 if dropout_p: 

1447 launch_options.update( 

1448 seed=seed, 

1449 rng_offset=rng_offset, 

1450 DROP_P=dropout_p, 

1451 DROP_KEEP=dropout_keep, 

1452 DROP_GROUP4=max_k % 4 == 0, 

1453 offset_intragraph=offset_intragraph, 

1454 RNG_DEVICE=rng_device, 

1455 ) 

1456 if not launch_options["FULL_PRECISION"]: 

1457 try: 

1458 scale32 = struct.unpack("f", struct.pack("f", scale))[0] 

1459 scale_log2 = struct.unpack( 

1460 "f", struct.pack("f", scale32 * math.log2(math.e)) 

1461 )[0] 

1462 except OverflowError: 

1463 scale_log2 = math.copysign(math.inf, scale) 

1464 can_fold_heads = ( 

1465 musa_dense 

1466 and dropout_p == 0 

1467 and dim in (64, 128) 

1468 and hq == hk 

1469 and hq > 1 

1470 and max_q == max_k 

1471 and max_q >= 256 

1472 and window_size_left is None 

1473 and window_size_right is None 

1474 and logsumexp.is_contiguous() 

1475 and all( 

1476 t.transpose(1, 2).is_contiguous() for t in (query, key, value, grad_out) 

1477 ) 

1478 ) 

1479 # Keep explicit default scale limited to the existing aligned D64 route. 

1480 explicit_aligned_d64 = ( 

1481 can_fold_heads 

1482 and not native_default_scale 

1483 and scale == default_scale 

1484 and dim == 64 

1485 and max_q == 1024 

1486 and 0 < query.numel() < 2**31 

1487 and (out.is_contiguous() or out.transpose(1, 2).is_contiguous()) 

1488 and not torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled() # allow-torch-compute: reads a runtime flag 

1489 and "S5000" in torch.musa.get_device_name(query.device) 

1490 ) 

1491 fold_heads = can_fold_heads and (native_default_scale or explicit_aligned_d64) 

1492 if ( 

1493 explicit_aligned_d64 or (can_fold_heads and native_default_scale and dim == 64) 

1494 ) and ( 

1495 (batch, hq, max_q) == (4, 16, 1024) 

1496 and (out.is_contiguous() or out.transpose(1, 2).is_contiguous()) 

1497 and not torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled() # allow-torch-compute: reads a runtime flag 

1498 and "S5000" in torch.musa.get_device_name(query.device) 

1499 ): 

1500 result = _musa_flash_bwd_d64_sdk( 

1501 query, key, value, out, grad_out, logsumexp, scale32, scale_log2, is_causal 

1502 ) 

1503 if result is not None: 

1504 return result 

1505 if ( 

1506 can_fold_heads 

1507 and (native_default_scale or scale == default_scale) 

1508 and batch > 0 

1509 and dim == 128 

1510 and max_q >= 1024 

1511 and max_q % 128 == 0 

1512 and query.numel() < 2**31 

1513 and (out.is_contiguous() or out.transpose(1, 2).is_contiguous()) 

1514 and not torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled() # allow-torch-compute: reads a runtime flag 

1515 and "S5000" in torch.musa.get_device_name(query.device) 

1516 ): 

1517 # Share QK/dP work between all gradients; dQ accumulates in FP32. 

1518 # Strict and warn-only determinism keep the disjoint-write path below. 

1519 pq, pk, pv, pdo = ( 

1520 tensor.transpose(1, 2) for tensor in (query, key, value, grad_out) 

1521 ) 

1522 po = out.transpose(1, 2) 

1523 pdq, pdk, pdv = (torch.empty_like(tensor) for tensor in (pq, pk, pv)) 

1524 d128_handle = _d128_prepare(pq, pk, pv, pdo, logsumexp, is_causal) 

1525 if d128_handle is not None: 

1526 # The MP31 main kernel writes dK/dV directly and 

1527 # accumulates dQ in a BHSD fp32 buffer. The delta kernel zeroes 

1528 # that buffer while computing delta because its DQA stores cover 

1529 # every flat element exactly once. 

1530 dq_accum = torch.empty( 

1531 (batch, hq, max_q, dim), dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device 

1532 ) 

1533 row_stats = torch.empty( 

1534 (batch, hq, max_q, 2), dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device 

1535 ) 

1536 _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_delta[(triton.cdiv(max_q, 32), batch * hq)]( 

1537 po, 

1538 pdo, 

1539 row_stats, 

1540 dq_accum, 

1541 max_q, 

1542 hq, 

1543 dim, 

1544 *po.stride()[:3], 

1545 32, 

1546 num_warps=4, 

1547 num_stages=1, 

1548 LSE=logsumexp, 

1549 SCALE=scale32, 

1550 ) 

1551 _d128_launch( 

1552 d128_handle, 

1553 pq, 

1554 pk, 

1555 pv, 

1556 pdo, 

1557 row_stats, 

1558 dq_accum, 

1559 pdk, 

1560 pdv, 

1561 scale32, 

1562 scale_log2, 

1563 ) 

1564 _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_cast[(triton.cdiv(pdq.numel(), 256),)]( 

1565 dq_accum, pdq, pdq.numel(), 256, num_warps=4 

1566 ) 

1567 return pdq, pdk, pdv 

1568 pdelta = torch.empty( 

1569 (batch * hq * max_q,), dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device 

1570 ) 

1571 pdqa = torch.empty_like(pq, dtype=torch.float32) 

1572 _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_delta[(triton.cdiv(max_q, 32), batch * hq)]( 

1573 po, 

1574 pdo, 

1575 pdelta, 

1576 pdqa, 

1577 max_q, 

1578 hq, 

1579 dim, 

1580 *po.stride()[:3], 

1581 32, 

1582 num_warps=4, 

1583 num_stages=1, 

1584 ) 

1585 sms = torch.musa.get_device_properties(query.device.index).multi_processor_count 

1586 _musa_flash_bwd_persistent[(min(sms, batch * hq * (max_k // 128)),)]( 

1587 pq, 

1588 pdo, 

1589 pk, 

1590 pv, 

1591 pdqa, 

1592 pdk, 

1593 pdv, 

1594 logsumexp, 

1595 pdelta, 

1596 max_q, 

1597 max_k, 

1598 dim, 

1599 64, 

1600 128, 

1601 128, 

1602 batch * hq, 

1603 sms, 

1604 is_causal, 

1605 scale, 

1606 scale_log2, 

1607 num_warps=16, 

1608 num_stages=1, 

1609 ) 

1610 _musa_flash_bwd_persistent_cast[(triton.cdiv(pq.numel(), 256),)]( 

1611 pdqa, 

1612 pdq, 

1613 pq.numel(), 

1614 256, 

1615 num_warps=4, 

1616 ) 

1617 return pdq, pdk, pdv 

1618 fold_out = fold_heads and out.is_contiguous() 

1619 out_heads = hq if fold_out else 0 

1620 if fold_heads: 

1621 # Dense MHA heads are independent when dropout is disabled. 

1622 batch *= hq 

1623 hq = hk = 1 

1624 total_q = batch * max_q 

1625 lb, lh, lt = max_q, max_q, 1 

1626 logsumexp = logsumexp.view(batch, 1, max_q) 

1627 q, k, v, do = (t.transpose(1, 2) for t in (query, key, value, grad_out)) 

1628 o = out.transpose(1, 2) 

1629 if not fold_out: 

1630 o = o.contiguous() 

1631 else: 

1632 q, k, v, o, do = (t.contiguous() for t in (query, key, value, out, grad_out)) 

1633 dq, dk, dv = (torch.empty_like(t) for t in (q, k, v)) 

1634 if batch == 0: 

1635 if q.numel() or k.numel(): 

1636 raise ValueError("zero sequences require empty packed inputs") 

1637 return ( 

1638 tuple(t.transpose(1, 2) for t in (dq, dk, dv)) 

1639 if musa_dense and not fold_heads 

1640 else (dq, dk, dv) 

1641 ) 

1642 tile = 32 

1643 num_warps = 4 

1644 dense_s5000 = fold_heads and "S5000" in torch.musa.get_device_name(query.device) 

1645 if dense_s5000: 

1646 # Contiguous S5000 rows favor synchronous loads and wider FP16 tiles. 

1647 launch_options["ASYNC_LOAD"] = False 

1648 if query.dtype == torch.float16 and not is_causal: 

1649 tile, num_warps = 64, 8 

1650 # Bound padded masked-lane addresses as well as valid elements. LSE may 

1651 # have nonstandard positive strides; its storage span, not numel, matters. 

1652 lse_span = 1 + sum( 

1653 (size - 1) * stride for size, stride in zip(logsumexp.shape, logsumexp.stride()) 

1654 ) 

1655 wide_sequence_indices = ( 

1656 max( 

1657 (max_q + tile - 1) * batch * hq * dim, 

1658 (max_k + tile - 1) * batch * hk * dim, 

1659 lse_span + (tile - 1) * lt, 

1660 ) 

1661 >= 2**31 

1662 ) 

1663 common = ( 

1664 max_q, 

1665 max_k, 

1666 total_q, 

1667 hq, 

1668 hk, 

1669 dim, 

1670 max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(dim)), 

1671 scale, 

1672 scale_log2, 

1673 lse_scale, 

1674 lb, 

1675 lh, 

1676 lt, 

1677 wl, 

1678 wr, 

1679 is_causal, 

1680 varlen, 

1681 varlen and padded_lse, 

1682 wide_sequence_indices, 

1683 ) 

1684 if ( 

1685 musa_dense 

1686 and dropout_p == 0 

1687 and hq == hk 

1688 and dim == 64 

1689 and max_q == max_k 

1690 and max_q <= 128 

1691 and not is_causal 

1692 and wl < 0 

1693 and wr < 0 

1694 ): 

1695 if max_q or max_k: 

1696 _musa_flash_bwd_small[ 

1697 (triton.cdiv(max(max_q, max_k), tile), batch, hq + hk) 

1698 ]( 

1699 q, 

1700 k, 

1701 v, 

1702 o, 

1703 do, 

1704 logsumexp, 

1705 dq, 

1706 dk, 

1707 dv, 

1708 cum_seq_q, 

1709 cum_seq_k, 

1710 *common, 

1711 BM=tile, 

1712 BN=tile, 

1713 num_warps=num_warps, 

1714 num_stages=1, 

1715 **launch_options, 

1716 ) 

1717 return ( 

1718 tuple(t.transpose(1, 2) for t in (dq, dk, dv)) 

1719 if musa_dense and not fold_heads 

1720 else (dq, dk, dv) 

1721 ) 

1722 dq_kernel = _musa_flash_bwd_dq 

1723 dkv_kernel = _musa_flash_bwd_dkv 

1724 # Independent backward-only zero-QK controls on S5000/MuDNN 3400 

1725 # establish unreliable masked tails beyond the actual Q extent rounded 

1726 # to 128 for the supported <=128 and dense-160 dimension families. 

1727 # Unsupported dimensions above already select the mathematical path. 

1728 # Device metadata selects one precision contract for the entire packed 

1729 # call; no device value is read by the host and references are not mixed 

1730 # between sequences. Declared max bounds do not decide this condition. 

1731 batch_tail_check = ( 

1732 varlen and is_causal and dim <= 160 and not launch_options["FULL_PRECISION"] 

1733 ) 

1734 if batch_tail_check: 

1735 tail_flag = torch.empty((), dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device) 

1736 _musa_flash_tail_metadata[(1,)]( 

1737 cum_seq_q, cum_seq_k, tail_flag, batch, BLOCK=256 

1738 ) 

1739 dq_kernel = _musa_flash_bwd_dq_tail 

1740 dkv_kernel = _musa_flash_bwd_dkv_tail 

1741 delta = torch.empty((hq, total_q), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device) 

1742 dq_extra = {"OUT_HEADS": out_heads} if fold_out else {} 

1743 # Burst combining changes native Delta/dS rounding. Preserve dQ's order 

1744 # and use the full optimization set only for the BF16 dKV consumer. 

1745 dkv_extra = {} 

1746 aligned_s = ( 

1747 dense_s5000 

1748 and dim == 64 

1749 and max_q == 1024 

1750 and max_k == 1024 

1751 and max_q % tile == 0 

1752 and max_k % tile == 0 

1753 and query.numel() > 0 

1754 and query.numel() < 2**31 

1755 and (out.is_contiguous() or out.transpose(1, 2).is_contiguous()) 

1756 and not torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled() # allow-torch-compute: reads a runtime flag 

1757 ) 

1758 if aligned_s: 

1759 dq_extra["ALIGNED_S"] = 1 

1760 dkv_extra["ALIGNED_S"] = 1 

1761 if dense_s5000: 

1762 # Select the compiler's SQMMA scheduling bundle. Older MUSA compilers 

1763 # cannot append custom llc_options to the unoptimized SQMMA flag set. 

1764 dq_extra.update(enable_backend_opt=True, enable_llc_opt=False) 

1765 dkv_extra.update( 

1766 enable_backend_opt=query.dtype == torch.bfloat16, 

1767 enable_llc_opt=False, 

1768 ) 

1769 for tail_math in [False, True] if batch_tail_check else [None]: 

1770 branch_options = dict(launch_options) 

1771 if tail_math is not None: 

1772 branch_options["TAIL_MATH"] = tail_math 

1773 branch_options["TAIL_FLAG"] = tail_flag 

1774 # Fixed-order, disjoint writes: deterministic in strict/warn/off modes. 

1775 if max_q: 

1776 dq_kernel[(triton.cdiv(max_q, tile), batch, hq)]( 

1777 q, 

1778 k, 

1779 v, 

1780 o, 

1781 do, 

1782 logsumexp, 

1783 delta, 

1784 dq, 

1785 cum_seq_q, 

1786 cum_seq_k, 

1787 *common, 

1788 BM=tile, 

1789 BN=tile, 

1790 num_warps=num_warps, 

1791 num_stages=1, 

1792 **branch_options, 

1793 **dq_extra, 

1794 ) 

1795 if max_k: 

1796 dkv_kernel[(triton.cdiv(max_k, tile), batch, hk)]( 

1797 q, 

1798 k, 

1799 v, 

1800 o, 

1801 do, 

1802 logsumexp, 

1803 delta, 

1804 dk, 

1805 dv, 

1806 cum_seq_q, 

1807 cum_seq_k, 

1808 *common, 

1809 BM=tile, 

1810 BN=tile, 

1811 num_warps=num_warps, 

1812 num_stages=1, 

1813 **branch_options, 

1814 **dkv_extra, 

1815 ) 

1816 return ( 

1817 tuple(t.transpose(1, 2) for t in (dq, dk, dv)) 

1818 if musa_dense and not fold_heads 

1819 else (dq, dk, dv) 

1820 )

1823def _d128_compiler_env(): 

1824 # Exclude include/library injection and ambient compiler overrides. 

1825 env = os.environ.copy() 

1826 for key in ( 

1827 "CPATH", 

1828 "CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH", 

1829 "C_INCLUDE_PATH", 

1830 "MUSA_INCLUDE_PATH", 

1831 "LIBRARY_PATH", 

1832 "COMPILER_PATH", 

1833 "GCC_EXEC_PREFIX", 

1834 "CCC_OVERRIDE_OPTIONS", 

1835 ): 

1836 env.pop(key, None) 

1837 return env 

1838 

1839 

1840@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=8) 

1841def _d128_toolchain(mcc, cxx, sdk): 

1842 env = _d128_compiler_env() 

1843 common = dict(env=env, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=15) 

1844 version = subprocess.check_output([mcc, "--version"], **common) 

1845 if b"mcc version 5.2.0" not in version: 

1846 raise OSError("D128 SDK path is qualified for mcc 5.2.0") 

1847 cxx_version = subprocess.check_output([cxx, "--version"], **common) 

1848 gcc_major = subprocess.check_output([cxx, "-dumpversion"], **common) 

1849 gcc_major = gcc_major.decode().strip().split(".", 1)[0] 

1850 cxx_include = Path("/usr/include/c++") / gcc_major 

1851 arch_include = Path("/usr/include/x86_64-linux-gnu/c++") / gcc_major 

1852 if not (cxx_include / "cmath").is_file() or not arch_include.is_dir(): 

1853 raise OSError("D128 SDK path requires the system GCC C++ headers") 

1854 includes = ( 

1855 "--gcc-toolchain=/usr", 

1856 "-isystem", 

1857 str(cxx_include), 

1858 "-isystem", 

1859 str(arch_include), 

1860 "-isystem", 

1861 str(cxx_include / "backward"), 

1862 ) 

1863 sdk_hash = hashlib.sha256() 

1864 for name in ( 

1865 "musa.h", 

1866 "musa_runtime.h", 

1867 "musa_robust.h", 

1868 "musa_burst.h", 

1869 "musa_bf16.h", 

1870 "musa_fp16.h", 

1871 ): 

1872 sdk_hash.update((sdk / "include" / name).read_bytes()) 

1873 return includes, (version, cxx_version, sdk_hash.hexdigest().encode()) 

1874 

1875 

1876def _d128_compile(cache, mcc, cxx, sdk, bf16, causal, *, head_dim=128): 

1877 device_cpp, host_cpp = ( 

1878 (_D64_DEVICE_CPP, _D64_HOST_CPP) 

1879 if head_dim == 64 

1880 else (_D128_DEVICE_CPP, _D128_HOST_CPP) 

1881 ) 

1882 includes, tool_ids = _d128_toolchain(mcc, cxx, sdk) 

1883 dtype_flags = ("-DFG_D128_BF16=1",) if bf16 else () 

1884 if causal: 

1885 dtype_flags += ("-DFG_D128_CAUSAL=1",) 

1886 flags = _D128_MCC_FLAGS + includes + dtype_flags 

1887 host_flags = ("-std=c++17", "-O2", "-shared", "-fPIC", f"-I{sdk / 'include'}") 

1888 key = hashlib.sha256() 

1889 for item in ( 

1890 *tool_ids, 

1891 *(os.fsencode(x) for x in (mcc, cxx, sdk)), 

1892 repr((flags, host_flags)).encode(), 

1893 device_cpp.encode(), 

1894 host_cpp.encode(), 

1895 ): 

1896 key.update(len(item).to_bytes(8, "little")) 

1897 key.update(item) 

1898 cache.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700, exist_ok=True) 

1899 destination = cache / key.hexdigest() 

1900 with destination.with_suffix(".lock").open("a") as lock: 

1901 fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX) 

1902 if (destination / "kernel.mubin").is_file() and ( 

1903 destination / "launcher.so" 

1904 ).is_file(): 

1905 return destination 

1906 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".d128-", dir=cache) as temporary: 

1907 stage = Path(temporary) / "artifact" 

1908 stage.mkdir(mode=0o700) 

1909 (stage / "kernel.mu").write_text(device_cpp) 

1910 (stage / "launcher.cc").write_text(host_cpp) 

1911 commands = ( 

1912 [ 

1913 mcc, 

1914 *flags, 

1915 "-MD", 

1916 "-MF", 

1917 "kernel.d", 

1918 "kernel.mu", 

1919 "-o", 

1920 "kernel.mubin", 

1921 ], 

1922 [ 

1923 cxx, 

1924 *host_flags, 

1925 "launcher.cc", 

1926 f"-L{sdk / 'lib'}", 

1927 "-l:libmusa.so.1", 

1928 "-o", 

1929 "launcher.so", 

1930 ], 

1931 ) 

1932 env = _d128_compiler_env() 

1933 for command in commands: 

1934 result = subprocess.run( 

1935 command, 

1936 cwd=stage, 

1937 env=env, 

1938 timeout=120, 

1939 stdout=subprocess.PIPE, 

1940 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, 

1941 text=True, 

1942 check=False, 

1943 ) 

1944 if result.returncode: 

1945 raise OSError( 

1946 f"{Path(command[0]).name} failed ({result.returncode}): " 

1947 f"{result.stdout[-2500:]}" 

1948 ) 

1949 (stage / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(commands)) 

1950 if destination.exists(): 

1951 # Recover a partial directory left by manual cache maintenance. 

1952 shutil.rmtree(destination) 

1953 stage.rename(destination) 

1954 return destination 

1955 

1956 

1957_D128_HANDLE_LOCK = threading.Lock() 

1958_D128_HANDLES = {} 

1959_D128_UNAVAILABLE = set() 

1960 

1961 

1962def _d128_prepare(q, k, v, dout, lse, causal, *, head_dim=128): 

1963 if os.getenv(f"FLAGGEMS_MUSA_BWD_D{head_dim}", "auto") not in ("auto", "cpp"): 

1964 return None 

1965 if q.device.type != "musa" or q.dtype not in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16): 

1966 return None 

1967 # The SDK tiles, including their packed row-statistics loads, assume this shape. 

1968 if any( 

1969 t.shape != (4, 16, 1024, head_dim) 

1970 or t.device != q.device 

1971 or t.dtype != q.dtype 

1972 or not t.is_contiguous() 

1973 for t in (q, k, v, dout) 

1974 ): 

1975 return None 

1976 if ( 

1977 lse.shape != (4, 16, 1024) 

1978 or lse.device != q.device 

1979 or lse.dtype != torch.float32 

1980 or not lse.is_contiguous() 

1981 ): 

1982 return None 

1983 if any(t.data_ptr() % 16 for t in (q, k, v, dout, lse)): 

1984 return None 

1985 with torch.musa.device(q.device): 

1986 properties = torch.musa.get_device_properties(q.device) 

1987 if (int(properties.major), int(properties.minor)) != (3, 1): 

1988 return None 

1989 is_capturing = getattr(torch.musa, "is_current_stream_capturing", None) 

1990 if is_capturing is not None and is_capturing(): 

1991 return None 

1992 sdk = Path(os.getenv("MUSA_HOME", "/usr/local/musa")) 

1993 mcc = shutil.which("mcc", path=f"{sdk / 'bin'}:{os.defpath}") 

1994 cxx = shutil.which("g++", path=os.defpath) 

1995 if not mcc or not cxx: 

1996 return None 

1997 cache = Path( 

1998 os.getenv(f"FLAGGEMS_MUSA_BWD_D{head_dim}_CACHE_DIR") 

1999 or Path(os.getenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", Path.home() / ".cache")) 

2000 / "flaggems" 

2001 / f"musa-flash-bwd-d{head_dim}" 

2002 ) 

2003 bf16 = q.dtype == torch.bfloat16 

2004 key = ( 

2005 os.getpid(), 

2006 q.device.index, 

2007 mcc, 

2008 cxx, 

2009 sdk, 

2010 cache, 

2011 bf16, 

2012 bool(causal), 

2013 head_dim, 

2014 ) 

2015 with _D128_HANDLE_LOCK: 

2016 if key in _D128_HANDLES: 

2017 return _D128_HANDLES[key] 

2018 if key in _D128_UNAVAILABLE: 

2019 return None 

2020 try: 

2021 artifact = _d128_compile( 

2022 cache, mcc, cxx, sdk, bf16, bool(causal), head_dim=head_dim 

2023 ) 

2024 lib = ctypes.CDLL(os.fspath(artifact / "launcher.so")) 

2025 ptr = ctypes.c_void_p 

2026 lib.mp31_load.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ptr)] 

2027 lib.mp31_load.restype = ctypes.c_int 

2028 lib.mp31_launch.argtypes = [ 

2029 ptr, 

2030 ptr, 

2031 ctypes.c_int, 

2032 *([ptr] * 8), 

2033 ctypes.c_float, 

2034 ctypes.c_float, 

2035 ] 

2036 lib.mp31_launch.restype = ctypes.c_int 

2037 function = ptr() 

2038 status = lib.mp31_load( 

2039 os.fsencode(artifact / "kernel.mubin"), ctypes.byref(function) 

2040 ) 

2041 if status or not function.value: 

2042 raise OSError( 

2043 f"MUSA module load/shared-memory opt-in failed ({status})" 

2044 ) 

2045 except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error: 

2046 _D128_UNAVAILABLE.add(key) 

2047 logger.debug("D%s SDK route unavailable: %s", head_dim, error) 

2048 return None 

2049 handle = lib, function, artifact 

2050 _D128_HANDLES[key] = handle 

2051 return handle 

2052 

2053 

2054def _d128_launch(handle, q, k, v, dout, row_stats, dq_accum, dk, dv, scale, scale_log2): 

2055 lib, function, _ = handle 

2056 tensors = q, k, v, dout, row_stats, dq_accum, dk, dv 

2057 with torch.musa.device(q.device): 

2058 stream = torch.musa.current_stream(q.device) 

2059 status = lib.mp31_launch( 

2060 function, 

2061 stream.musa_stream, 

2062 int(q.dtype == torch.bfloat16), 

2063 *(tensor.data_ptr() for tensor in tensors), 

2064 scale, 

2065 scale_log2, 

2066 ) 

2067 if status: 

2068 raise RuntimeError(f"D128 SDK kernel launch failed ({status})") 

2069 for tensor in tensors: 

2070 tensor.record_stream(stream) 

2071 

2072 

2073_D128_MCC_FLAGS = ( 

2074 "--cuda-device-only", 

2075 "--cuda-gpu-arch=mp_31", 

2076 "-std=c++17", 

2077 "-Wno-error=address-of-temporary", 

2078 "-Wno-error=c++11-narrowing", 

2079 "-D__MUSA_ARCH_LIST__=310", 

2080 "-mllvm", 

2081 "-mtgpu-alloc-shared-memory-from-zero=1", 

2082 "-fmusa-flush-denormals-to-zero", 

2083 "-fno-signed-zeros", 

2084 "-fno-strict-aliasing", 

2085 "-mllvm", 

2086 "-misched=mtgpu-max-ilp", 

2087 "-mllvm", 

2088 "-mtgpu-tiny-offset-hint=1", 

2089 "-mllvm", 

2090 "-misched-recompute-slotindex=1", 

2091 "-mllvm", 

2092 "-mtgpu-if-convert=1", 

2093 "-mllvm", 

2094 "-mtgpu-combine-fop-instr=1", 

2095)
